items.title: The pullback of a small etale sheaf to the ph-topology is described by the sections of its small pullback
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the pullback of a small etale sheaf to the ph-topology with the rule sending f : X -> S to the sections of f_small^{-1}F (statement lines 22174-22186). The proof (proof lines 22188-22249) quotes the etale description, reduces the claim to the ph-sheaf condition through the characterisation of ph-sheaves by equalizers along proper surjective morphisms, rewrites the terms as sections of two pushforwards, and verifies the resulting equalizer statement on geometric stalks using the description of the stalk of a proper pushforward. H2: one reduction plus one stalk computation, written out.
